tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Yusuf wants to talk about reading practice. which page to read. what words to learn. when to practise.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Yusuf.

promptBlocks.subject: Reading practice
paragraphs: I am writing about reading practice. which page to read? what words to learn?
when to practise? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Yusuf and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: reading practice
ketImageBrief.panel1: Yusuf starts reading practice with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Yusuf solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
